text:
Just done 2nd test with my new GTA Vice City 🌆 vibe with AI gaming style 

Seedance 2 Model on @magnific 

Use extended feature of Magnific 

Thank you for your support and prompt guide @techhalla https://t.co/3EYj56fhdi
content: Use the extended feature in Magnific when running Seedance 2 Model to enhance an AI gaming-style (e.g., GTA Vice City vibe) output.

extra_content.quoted_text:
